parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides deeper personalization by citing multiple specific profile attributes (net worth gap, income, expenses, 10-year horizon, catch-up eligibility) with concrete tickers, allocation percentages, and time-bound execution steps. System B contains internal inconsistencies (e.g., Rec #1 suggests reallocating tech proceeds to healthcare while healthcare is already overweight at 22%, and Rec #2 further increases the already-overweight healthcare sector), weakening its diversification awareness and factual grounding.
